items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: I joined the band. That's when Carroll Dickerson was made the leader; he was put in front of the band

ctx.x: And that's when you joined again.

Well, soon after that. I don't remember whether it was the first week or not. I think they were in the club when I went in, you know, for a few days or something like that, when I joined the band. That's when Carroll Dickerson was made the leader; he was put in front of the band...
That's when Mills called the band Earl Jackson...
